# Stave

> Stave is a free piano practice web app (PWA) for students taking ABRSM and Trinity graded exams in the UK, and their teachers. It runs in the browser and works offline.

What it does:
- Note-reading flashcards that repeat the notes you miss.
- A daily practice plan built from your grade, exam board, lesson day and the bars you keep getting wrong.
- Play a piece into the microphone (or a MIDI keyboard) and see every right, wrong, early, late and missed note, with "kept going" and pulse scores.
- An exam countdown with weekly targets, a Pitch & Time readiness band for each piece (not an exam mark), and a mock exam in the real order.
- Pieces-only exams (ABRSM Performance Grade, Trinity repertoire-only): four pieces, no scales or sight-reading, and a video recorder whose videos stay on the phone.
- Optional accounts (username and password, no email) so teachers can set work and see a practice summary, and a private parent link.

No adverts, no tracking, no data sold. Not connected to ABRSM or Trinity College London.
